references.title: 勞動基準法第38條 — 3 days after six months' continuous service, 7 after one year, 10 after two, 14 after three, 15 after five and one further day for every year beyond ten, capped at 30; the worker schedules the days and any unused day is paid out at the year end or on termination. 僱用部分時間工作勞工應行注意事項 (MOL, amended 2022-03-14) 三(三)–(四): a part-timer’s 特別休假 is their normal hours a year over a full-timer’s × the LSA §38 days, and 婚喪事病假 hours are their average weekly hours ÷ 40 × the days × 8. `entitlement.scale` states both in the part-timer’s own days (× 8 ÷ their hours a day), so a part-timer working the full-timer’s five days on shorter hours keeps the §38 days, as the guideline’s proviso requires. The guideline says “得參考” (may be referred to): it is MOL guidance, not a statute. 勞動基準法第38條第4項: 特別休假因年度終結而未休之日數，雇主應發給工資; 施行細則第24條之1第2項第1款: 年度終結者於契約約定之工資給付日發給或於年度終結後三十日內發給. The unused days are raised by its schedule on the leave year’s last day; a deferral the parties agreed under §38(4) is HR’s to record by rejecting the request and waiving the duty with its reason.

勞動基準法 §38(1): 3 days after six months, 7 after one year, 10 after two, 14 after three, 15 after five, and from ten years one more for each year to 30 at twenty-four years. 施行細則 §24(2)(1): each year from the day of hire. §38(4): unused days are paid; they carry only where the parties agree.

name: Ordinary injury or sickness leave (普通傷病假)

references.title: 勞工請假規則第4條 — not more than 30 days a year where the worker is not hospitalised, at half wages; hospitalised leave is capped at one year within two years and 未住院傷病假 plus 住院傷病假 together at one year within two years. 僱用部分時間工作勞工應行注意事項 (MOL, amended 2022-03-14) 三(三)–(四): a part-timer’s 特別休假 is their normal hours a year over a full-timer’s × the LSA §38 days, and 婚喪事病假 hours are their average weekly hours ÷ 40 × the days × 8. `entitlement.scale` states both in the part-timer’s own days (× 8 ÷ their hours a day), so a part-timer working the full-timer’s five days on shorter hours keeps the §38 days, as the guideline’s proviso requires. The guideline says “得參考” (may be referred to): it is MOL guidance, not a statute. 勞工請假規則 §4(1)(1): 未住院者，一年內合計不得超過三十日 — metered by calendar year.
勞工請假規則 §4(1)(1): 未住院者，一年內合計不得超過三十日.

name: Personal leave (事假)

references.title: 勞工請假規則 §7: personal leave is unpaid and at most fourteen days in a calendar year.

勞工請假規則第2條 — 8 days on full wages. 勞工請假規則 §2: 結婚者給予婚假八日 — per marriage (entry facts.event_id). Taken from ten days before the marriage registration to three months after it, or within a year with the employer’s agreement (勞動部 104-10-07 勞動3字第1040130270號令; entry facts marriage_date, taken_within_a_year_by_agreement): outside that window nothing is granted.
勞工請假規則 §2, until 2026-09-30: 勞工結婚者給予婚假八日.

勞工請假規則第3條 — 8 days on the death of a parent, adoptive or foster parent, or spouse; 6 days for a grandparent, child, or the spouse's parent or adoptive/foster parent; 3 days for a great-grandparent, sibling, or the spouse's grandparent. All are on full wages. eight days for a parent, step-parent or spouse; six for a grandparent, child or parent-in-law; three for a great-grandparent, sibling or spouse’s grandparent (勞工請假規則 §3; `event.relationship`), per death. 勞工請假規則 §3: eight days for a parent, step- or adoptive parent or spouse; six for a grandparent, child, or the spouse’s parent, step- or adoptive parent; three for a great-grandparent, sibling or the spouse’s grandparent — and no days for any other relationship. Metered per death (facts.event_id) by facts.relationship: PARENT, ADOPTIVE_PARENT, STEP_PARENT, SPOUSE 8; GRANDPARENT, CHILD, PARENT_IN_LAW, ADOPTIVE_PARENT_IN_LAW, STEP_PARENT_IN_LAW 6; GREAT_GRANDPARENT, SIBLING, GRANDPARENT_IN_LAW 3; any other none (勞工請假規則 §3).
勞工請假規則第6條 with 勞動基準法第59條 — leave for the whole period of medical treatment and recuperation for an occupational injury or disease, with no day cap, at the 原領工資數額.

name: Maternity leave (產假)

references.title: 性別平等工作法第15條第1項 with 勞動基準法第50條 — 8 weeks before and after childbirth; 4 weeks for a miscarriage at three months or more, 1 week at two months to under three, 5 days under two months. Wages are paid in full where service is six months or more and at half where it is less. a grant per event — eight weeks for a birth, four for a miscarriage after three months of pregnancy, one week after two, five days under two (勞基法 §50(1), 性平法 §15; `event.kind`) — at full wages after six months’ service, half before (§50(2)). 勞基法 §50(2): full pay after six months’ service, half before, for the eight weeks and the four-week leave for a miscarriage after three months of pregnancy; 性別平等工作法 §15(1): the one-week and five-day leaves for an earlier miscarriage are leave the employer need not pay. Metered per event (facts.event_id) by facts.event_kind: BIRTH 56 days (8 weeks), MISCARRIAGE_3M 28, MISCARRIAGE_2M 7, MISCARRIAGE_UNDER_2M 5 (勞基法 §50(1), 性平法 §15(1)). The weeks and miscarriage durations run by calendar days, including public holidays, rest days and regular days off; CALENDAR_DAY meters that duration. MOL/OSHA Q56: https://www.osha.gov.tw/media/u1hltoy3/勞動基準法qa百問百答第二版.pdf

性別平等工作法 §15(4): 受僱者妊娠期間，雇主應給予產檢假七日.

name: Menstrual leave (生理假)

references.title: 性別平等工作法第14條 — one day a month; up to three days a year are not counted against the 30-day ordinary sickness quota and days beyond three are counted into it. Every day is at half wages. 性別平等工作法 §14: one day a month; three days a year are outside the thirty-day ordinary sickness quota and every day beyond them counts into it (`consumes_code`, `consumes_after_days`). MOL clarification 2021-03-12: after the annual paid sick pool and exempt days are exhausted, the monthly menstrual day must still be granted; it may be unpaid. On that clarification the overflow days are granted unpaid, keeping the one-day monthly entitlement (MENSTRUAL_LEAVE_UNPAID). Metered one day a calendar month (window keyed by the month of the leave day; 性別平等工作法 §14).

name: Menstrual leave beyond the sick pool, unpaid (生理假)

references.title: 性別平等工作法 §14 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030014&flno=14): one menstrual day a month; three a year outside the sick pool, the rest inside it at half pay. Once the three days and the thirty-day half-paid pool (勞工請假規則 §4(3)) are spent, the monthly day is still granted, unpaid (Ministry of Labor clarification 2021-03-12, https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/1632/1640/32923/post). Open only then, one day a calendar month together with MENSTRUAL_LEAVE; not an absence for the attendance bonus (§21(2)).

name: Family care leave (家庭照顧假)

references.title: 性別平等工作法 §20: seven days a year of unpaid family-care leave, counted inside the fourteen days of personal leave; the row draws its days from the PERSONAL_LEAVE pool.

name: Parental leave without pay (育嬰留職停薪)

references.title: 性別平等工作法 §16(1): after six months' service, unpaid parental leave until the child turns three, for at most two years per child; the 就業保險 parental allowance is 60% of the insured salary.

name: Breastfeeding and milk-expressing time (哺乳及集乳時間)

references.title: 性別平等工作法第18條 — 60 minutes a day for a child under two, with a further 30 minutes where extended work exceeds one hour; the time counts as paid working time.

references.title: 勞工請假規則 §4(1)(2)–(3): up to one year of hospitalised sickness leave within any two years, and the non-hospitalised and hospitalised days together not more than one year within two; outpatient cancer treatment and 安胎休養 count as hospitalised. §4(2): half pay for the days inside thirty a year, none beyond (the 勞保 sickness benefit stands in). The rolling twenty-four-month pool of 365 days is shared with the outpatient row. Half pay within the thirty-day pool it shares with SICK_LEAVE (and menstrual days beyond three); hospitalised days beyond the pool are SICK_LEAVE_UNPAID. Outpatient cancer treatment and 安胎休養 are recorded here (§4(2)). Half pay within the thirty-day pool it shares with SICK_LEAVE (and menstrual days beyond three); hospitalised days beyond the pool are SICK_LEAVE_UNPAID. Outpatient cancer treatment and 安胎休養 are recorded here (§4(2)).

references.title: 勞工請假規則 §8: leave with pay for the days the law requires the worker to attend to a public duty — military service call-up, a summons, an election; not metered.

勞基法 §16(2): 勞工於接到前項預告後，為另謀工作得於工作時間請假外出。其請假時數，每星期不得超過二日之工作時間，請假期間之工資照給 — paid leave to look for work after the §16(1) notice of an employer termination under §11 or the §13 proviso; §20 applies the same periods. the grant follows the notice ground as SEVERANCE_PAY’s notice pay does (`exit_facts.lsa_termination_ground`, else REDUNDANCY or RETRENCHMENT read as §11). the two-working-day weekly limit is `weekly_days` 2, counted Monday to Sunday, and a day is granted only inside the notice — fewer calendar days before exit_date than `exit_facts.notice_days_given` (the days from the day after notice to the last working day, 民法 §120(2)). No recorded actual notice means no §16(2) leave, because the worker has not been shown to have received the preceding §16(1) notice. Two days in each week (Monday-to-Sunday) of the notice, on a §11, §13-proviso or §20 termination. Two days in each week (Monday-to-Sunday) of the notice, on a §11, §13-proviso or §20 termination.

name: 例假補假 (statutory rest day in lieu)

references.title: 勞動基準法 §40: 因天災、事變或突發事件停止 §36 例假者，工資應加倍發給，並應於事後補假休息 — the day off in lieu HR credits on this row, a day for each statutory rest day worked (payroll prices the day itself at a further day’s wage, REST-STATUTORY-DOUBLE).

name: 補休 (time off in lieu of overtime pay)

references.title: 勞動基準法 §32-1(1): overtime or 休息日 work the worker elects to take as time off is banked by the hour (roster_entry.banked_overtime_hours, unpaid as overtime: work.days[].overtime_hours excludes it); 施行細則 §22-2: the hours are taken within the agreed period. Metered in hours over the leave (service) year: the hours banked so far less those taken. §32-1(2): hours untaken at the period’s end or on termination are paid at the wage of the day they were worked (COMP_TIME_YEAR_END_PAYMENT, OVERTIME_COMP_TIME_SETTLEMENT).

name: 補休未休工資 (untaken 補休, in straight-time hours)

references.title: 勞動基準法 §32-1(2) (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030001&flno=32-1); 施行細則 §22-2 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030002&flno=22-2): 補休 hours untaken when the agreed period ends or the contract terminates are paid at the wage of the day they were worked. Not a leave anyone takes (a dated time-off entry is refused: !has(entry.from)): its balance is the untaken banked hours of the leave year — the oldest taken first — each at its band (roster_entry.banked_overtime_band, the §24 multiplier: 1.34 or 1.67; blank priced 1.34), in straight-time hours. The exit encashment pays it (COMP_TIME_PAYOUT at the hourly wage); at the year’s end HR encashes the balance shown (COMP_TIME_YEAR_END_PAYMENT).

name: 普通傷病假（無薪）

references.title: 勞工請假規則 §4(1)(2)–(3): sickness beyond the thirty half-paid days a year is unpaid; non-hospitalised and hospitalised sickness together at most one year within any two (a rolling 24-month window).

name: 傷病留職停薪

references.title: 勞工請假規則 §5: sickness beyond the §4 limits may be taken as personal or annual leave, then as unpaid suspension (留職停薪) of at most one year (per illness: facts.event_id).
